recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original removal of MessageHeader.timestamp from current example source without changing the already-correct Bundle.timestamp semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13840 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked for a persistent Bundle date because Bundle.meta.lastUpdated is server-specific and Composition.date is not the document assembly time; the final resolution was to add Bundle.timestamp, document/message/query-response guidance distinguishing it from meta.lastUpdated, and remove MessageHeader.timestamp in favor of Bundle.timestamp.
initial_application: Git commit c3463df3ff5896ae7f6771267a31325bc6a3302f, imported from svn revision 12717, applied #13840 by adding Bundle.timestamp, Bundle timestamp search support, document/message/searchset usage text, Bundle-level timestamps on message request/response examples, and MessageHeader guidance pointing to Bundle.timestamp. It marked MessageHeader.timestamp as removed in the spreadsheet source but left the standalone MessageHeader example's old timestamp as an XML comment.
additional_context: Bundle and MessageHeader are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Bundle source already defines Bundle.timestamp, requires it for document Bundles, explains document/message/history/searchset usage and meta.lastUpdated distinctions, and MessageHeader definition/narrative/messaging pages point message time to Bundle.timestamp. A 2019 Zulip thread identified GF#13840 as the reason Bundle.timestamp was added in R4 and MessageHeader.timestamp removed. Later FHIR-20522 MessageHeader endpoint work copied the stale commented timestamp into a second example file, but that Jira is not a timestamp decision.
reconciliation: Removed only the stale commented-out MessageHeader timestamp lines from source/messageheader/messageheader-example.xml and source/messageheader/message-header-example.xml. No Bundle.timestamp definitions or current message/document guidance were changed.
source_changes: source/messageheader/messageheader-example.xml: removed a commented-out <timestamp value="2012-01-04T09:10:14Z"/> line from the active standalone MessageHeader example.
source/messageheader/message-header-example.xml: removed the copied commented-out MessageHeader timestamp line from the later Bundle/example source.
